title: Suspect went into medical distress: SIU
article: The Province's Special Investigations Unit (SIU) says a man who died while in Peel Regional Police custody on Sunday went into medical distress shortly after being arrested near Pearson International Airport.

The SIU is continuing its probe into the circumstances surrounding the death. The agency said today that Peel police officers interacted with Keith Prescod, 53, of Toronto, near an airport area ramp leading to Terminal 3 at about 2:15 a.m.
Prescod was restrained and went into medical distress, the SIU said. He was then taken to hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
A post-mortem was conducted today. Results are not yet available.

The SIU investigates reports involving police where there has been a death, serious injury or allegations of sexual assault. It has designated three Peel officers as subject officers and eight others as witness officers.
Anyone with information is asked to call the SIU at 416-622-1886 or 1-800-787-8529, ext. 1886.
